text: Julia starts at the new agency on Monday. She's nervous about the commute more than the job itself.
Karim got the promotion to team lead! Announced it at the Friday meeting. Need to send him a proper congratulations message tonight.
Neha is expecting again, due early March. Her husband Ivan is already panicking about the car seat situation.
Christening for little Rosa is on the 12th at half 9, St Mary's. Theo and Chloe asked me to be a godparent, which I'm still taking in.
Marcus is retiring at the end of the month after thirty-one years at the depot. Collection going round; I should chip in and sign the card before Thursday.

Bumped into Fern at the station. Her sister Manon has just had twins, a boy and a girl, born Tuesday morning. Fern is flying out to Lyon sometime next week to help, and their mum is joining her at the weekend. Fern says Manon's husband has barely slept and is due back at work on the 1st, which nobody is happy about.
Dentist moved to Wednesday at 4:15.

Yara handed in her notice today. Her last day is the 28th and she hasn't decided what's next. She seemed relieved more than anything. Her boss had been piling more on her since March and she'd been dreading Mondays. Her mum keeps telling her to get something lined up first, but Yara wants a month off over the summer to travel before looking properly.
Don't forget to ask Sunil how his first week at the hospital went. He started on nights, poor thing.
Mei and her partner Jin are moving to Bristol over the summer because Jin got a lectureship there. Mei will keep working remotely.
Lunch with Ayesha. She's twelve weeks pregnant and only just told her parents. Morning sickness has been brutal and she's struggling to get through the school day. Check in with her next week.
Katarzyna Kowalski, or Kasia as everyone calls her, is the new office manager. Starts Monday at 8. Apparently she used to run a bakery.
Darius's dad had his retirement do last night. Darius made a speech and nearly cried. His dad wants to take up sailing now.

Amir called. His wife Lola went into labour at 2am and baby Zain arrived just after lunch, 7lb 3oz. Everyone is fine. Lola's mum is staying with them for the first fortnight, and Amir has two weeks of paternity leave before his new contract starts in December. Must send flowers tomorrow morning.
Finn didn't get the job at the council. He's pretty gutted and says he's going to take a break from applying until after Christmas.
Remind me to text Claire on Thursday evening to wish her luck for her interview Friday at 10. It's for the deputy head role.
Picked up the cot from Suzanne's. She says her daughter Jaya is due any day now and has gone very quiet on the group chat.

Aurelio's leaving drinks were supposed to be Friday but they've been cancelled because half the team has flu. He leaves on the 3rd regardless. Someone suggested doing something in the new year instead once everyone's better, maybe mid-January. He's off to a start-up in Manchester and seemed a bit sad nobody would get to say goodbye properly.
Naledi's brother Kai has started his apprenticeship as an electrician. She says he's loving it and already wants his own van.
I'm doing the cake for Sophie's baby shower on Saturday afternoon. Need to buy the food colouring and a bigger tin.
Yosef got promoted to senior engineer. His wife Marta told me before he did, so act surprised when he mentions it.
Anan is going back to work after maternity leave in early January. She's worried about leaving the baby at nursery and keeps changing her mind about part time.
Book MOT for sometime next week, ideally before 9am.

Talked to Luis after football. His girlfriend Manon is pregnant, due late spring. He's over the moon but terrified, and his mum has already started knitting. They want to find out the sex at the scan on the 20th. I should ask him how the scan went.
Sunil's mum is retiring from nursing at the end of November. He wants to throw her a surprise lunch and asked if I'd help plan it.
Theo's first day at the bank was yesterday. Ask him how it went when I see him Saturday morning.
Chloe's maternity leave starts on Friday. Her team got her a pram and she cried at her desk, apparently.
Julia mentioned her husband Karim keeps hinting he'd like a proper espresso machine for his fortieth. Worth remembering.
Ivan Olsen from finance is leaving to go travelling for a year. Last day is the 15th, leaving lunch at 1pm.
Mrs Tanaka next door has a new kitten called Biscuit. She says it's keeping her up all night.
Ayesha's scan went well and the baby is measuring fine. She's much calmer now.
Need to message Jin before the end of the week about the christening. Mei wants to know if we can do a reading.

Spoke to Fern again. Manon and the twins are home now. Manon is exhausted and her husband went back to work after only a week, which Fern is furious about. Fern is staying until mid-December. I should send something for the babies, maybe the little knitted hats.
Marcus says his wife Suzanne is planning a big trip to Japan for spring once he's finished at the depot.
Neha's first day back at the practice is Tuesday at 9. She sounded nervous on the phone.
Claire got the deputy head job! She starts after Easter. Must take her out for a drink.
Grocery run tomorrow. Also cancel the gym membership before the 1st.
Kai and his partner Sophie are expecting their first in the summer. They told everyone at Sunday lunch and his gran screamed.
Darius has been signed off work with stress for two weeks. His manager has been awful since the restructure. Text him on Wednesday afternoon to see how he's doing.
Yara starts her new job at the charity on the 4th. She took a pay cut but says she doesn't care.

Coffee with Katarzyna. Her son Finn is starting nursery in January and she's dreading it more than he is. Her husband works away a lot so drop-offs will be all her. She asked whether I knew anyone with a child at Little Acorns, so I should ask Chloe tonight since her nephew went there last year.

Aurelio Santos is moving to Lisbon in the new year to head up the European office. His wife Marta is staying here until the kids finish the school year in July, then they'll follow. Marta is not thrilled about doing six months on her own with three kids and a dog, and her own job is busy. Aurelio flies out on the 6th of January, first thing in the morning.
Lola and Amir have set the christening for the last Sunday in November at 11. Lunch afterwards at her parents'. I'm bringing dessert.
Neha said her brother Theo is about to become a dad too. His wife is due sometime in February.

Chat with Jaya about the job offer from Wang & Co. She has until Monday at noon to decide and is torn because it means relocating. Her partner is supportive but his own job is here. Ask her what she decided early next week.
Note to self: Uncle Sunil's retirement party is Saturday the 9th at 7pm. Bring the photo album.
Mei loves orchids and has about twenty of them on her windowsill.
Anan's husband Yosef is starting as head of IT after half term. He mentioned it twice, so he must be excited.
Finn texted to say his dog Pepper had surgery this morning and is recovering well. He's been a mess all day.
Should call Julia this weekend. It's been ages and I want to hear about the new agency.
Luis is going part time from next month to look after his dad, who isn't doing well since the stroke.

Ivan's wife Neha had the baby on Sunday night! A girl, Elena. Ivan sounded completely shattered but happy. They're home from hospital tomorrow afternoon and want visitors from the weekend. Don't forget to drop off the lasagne before then.
Suzanne thinks Jaya would love a baby carrier rather than more clothes. Noted.
Kai has his promotion panel on Thursday at 2pm and is really anxious about it. Wish him luck Wednesday night.
Marta Fernández has joined our team from the Madrid office. She's vegetarian and a big climber, goes most weekends.
Interesting evening.
Karim said his sister Yara's wedding was called off. She and her fiancé split up last month and she's moved back in with their parents for now.
Darius is back at work from Monday on a phased return, mornings only for the first fortnight. He seems a bit brighter.

Theo and Chloe's baby is due around the middle of April. Chloe is having a hard pregnancy and has been in and out of the day unit. Theo is trying to sort paternity leave but his boss is being difficult. Must check in on Chloe sometime next week, and maybe ask Theo if he needs anything for the nursery.
Remember Naledi's last day at the library is Friday. She's retiring after twenty years; cake in the staff room at 3.
